name: markitdown
description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
one_liner: A free tool that turns messy files — PDFs, Word docs, Excel sheets, PowerPoints, even audio — into clean, readable text that an AI system can actually understand.
buyer: An operations manager at a company sitting on years of scanned contracts, reports, and PDFs who needs that pile turned into searchable, AI-readable text before any chatbot or search tool can be useful.
business_use_cases: A law firm converts its archive of contracts and case PDFs into clean text so an in-house AI assistant can search and summarize them instantly.
An HR team feeds hundreds of resumes (PDF/Word) through it to build a searchable, structured candidate database.
A market research firm converts client PowerPoint decks and Excel data dumps into Markdown so an AI can compare and summarize findings across dozens of reports at once.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted 'drag-and-drop your files, get clean Markdown back' web service for non-technical office teams who don't want to install Python.
Build a document-ingestion pipeline product for a specific vertical (legal, healthcare, real estate) that wraps this tool with vertical-specific cleanup and delivers ready-to-search knowledge bases.

steal_this: Build a simple weekend tool: a folder-watcher that runs every new file in a company's Dropbox/Drive through this converter and drops clean Markdown into a searchable Notion or Obsidian vault.
